items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: My mother's name Augustine and they named me August.

ctx.x: When were you born if you don't mind telling us? 1897. And the exact birthday? 28th of August. August 28th.
St. August, listen. I'm on 28th day of August. St. Augustine day. My mother's name Augustine and they named me August. All that on that scene. Yeah.
